Bihar Cricket Team Defeats Delhi in Syed Mushtaq Ali Trophy Match

In the Syed Mushtaq Ali Trophy, the Bihar cricket team achieved a victory against a Delhi team that included star players. Despite Delhi's Yash Dhull scoring 125 runs off 59 balls, Bihar successfully chased a target of 225 runs, winning by 2 wickets. Ayush Loharuka of Bihar scored a half-century in the match. Bihar's team played strongly even without Vaibhav Suryavanshi.
